note: The parts this site's pages are built from: what each is, its file, and when to use it. Koati reads this file from the main branch and shows it on Brand. A new part goes here in the same pull request that makes it.

parts.name: Page
parts.use: Every page sits in it: the brand's tokens, the measure, and Koati's one line. One layout for the whole site.

parts.name: Main heading
parts.use: The page's one h1, from its heading. Says what the page is in a few words.

parts.name: Lede
parts.use: The sentence or two under the heading, from its lede. Who it's for and what changes for them.

parts.name: Button
parts.use: The .cta: the one thing on the page to press, on --accent. One per page. There is no second kind.
